 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1 .

This is a repeat (second) application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 4.1.2023 in connection with Crime No. 8/2023, registered at Police Station Chand District Chhindwara for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1), 342 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix has already been examined in the Court.
There is no chances that applicant will be able to tamper with the evidence or influence the witnesses of the case.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.

It is submitted by him that prosecutrix has made allegation against the applicant that she was forcefully taken by applicant Vicky Satakar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2087129/
1 under the influence of stupefying drugs and rape has been committed on her.

Considering the fact that prosecutrix has already been examined in the Court and now there is no chances that applicant will be able to tamper with the evidence or influence the witnesses, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
